originalTitle: Dow Jones Futures: Market Rally Repairs Some Damage; Nvidia, CrowdStrike, Warsh In Focus
summary: The market rally suffered damage last week, though bitcoin and gold shined. Nvidia and CrowdStrike earnings are critical while Fed's Warsh will make a big speech.
content: The market rally suffered damage last week, though bitcoin and gold shined. Nvidia and CrowdStrike earnings are critical while Fed's Warsh will make a big speech.
